entities.summary: Cinema Glory was a Moscow theater landmark in Moscow and Perovo District. It was set on fire twice; most recently on February 3, 2007, by an unidentified person. The theater remained closed thereafter. The cinema historically housed 2 auditoriums with a total of 440 seats. The cinema had 3 floors. The cinema also had rooms with a restaurant, pool tables, café and sushi bar.
